name: hound-tracer
description: Offline-first diagnostic, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and quality gate plugin for troubleshooting CI/CD, build, test, and container crashes.

commands.name: hound:engine
commands.description: Access the shared diagnostic engine through available harness tools

commands.name: hound:analyze
commands.description: Diagnose failure logs or test reports using Hound Tracer RCA engine

commands.name: hound:run
commands.description: Execute a test or build command, redact secrets, and auto-diagnose failures

commands.name: hound:gate
commands.description: Evaluate test and coverage reports against project quality gates

commands.name: hound:insights
commands.description: Check test flakiness rates and duration percentiles

commands.name: hound:doctor
commands.description: Check local environment and tooling readiness for Hound Tracer

commands.name: hound:incidents
commands.description: List deduplicated failure incidents and recurrence counts

commands.name: hound:update
commands.description: Inspect and safely update Hound Tracer after confirmation

postExecution.description: Suggests running Hound RCA when a test runner or build command fails with exit code != 0
